note: First edition, to be ratified by the owner (G-78). Every rule is a condition the one engine evaluates over a derived namespace: worst.severity, areas.atHigh, areas.atMedium, area.<key>.severity, findings.*, controls.* — plus every intake field, gate and part. A rating is a band with its reasons; no number is ever shown.

default.because: nothing answered so far rates higher

rules.because: at least one severity answer is Medium or higher
at least one severity answer is High
two or more risk areas are at High
personal data at High severity in an activity that uses AI

residual.note: Starts from the inherent band and moves by whole bands, never above Critical or below Low; every step names its reason.

rules.because: an answer contradicts a policy clause and nothing has settled it
a high-weight control is not in place and nothing has settled it
a promised fix is past its date
a risk is accepted for now — the rating holds until the acceptance lapses
every required control is attested and the high-weight ones are in place

appetite.because: a Critical residual rating is outside the stated appetite
personal data above Medium needs the privacy office
